title: Courtyard decking
summary: A timber deck across a walled courtyard garden, laid on a new frame.
intro: A small walled garden in Camden Town, decked from the back doors to the far wall. Membrane down first, then a timber frame set level, then the boards, cut in neatly round the walls and the doors.

cover.alt: Timber decking across a walled courtyard garden

before.alt: Garden covered in weed membrane before the deck

after.alt: The finished deck in the same corner

compare.caption: Same corner of the garden before and after. Drag the handle to compare.

steps.title: Membrane down
steps.text: Weed membrane laid across the whole garden.

image.alt: Weed membrane laid across the garden

steps.title: Frame laid
steps.text: A timber frame set out and levelled.

image.alt: Timber frame laid across the garden

steps.title: Packed level
steps.text: Blocks under the joists bring the frame up level.

image.alt: Joists sitting on blocks at the far end of the garden

steps.title: Up to the doors
steps.text: The frame taken right up to the doors.

image.alt: Frame running up to the doors

steps.title: Boards ready
steps.text: The deck boards stacked down the side of the house, ready to go down.

image.alt: Stack of deck boards along the side wall

steps.title: From the doors out
steps.text: The first boards fixed at the doors, working out across the frame.

image.alt: First deck boards fixed at the back doors over the frame

steps.title: Boards on
steps.text: Boards fixed down and cut in round the walls.

steps.title: Edges finished
steps.text: A board runs along the edge as a border, and the deck stops neatly at the planters.
